description: Turn the article's own ideas into a diagram (flowchart, sequence, mindmap, timeline, pie, quadrant…) — best for structure/process/comparison paragraphs where a stock photo would be off-topic. Copyright-clean (basis=original). Give valid Mermaid code; Korean labels are fine. If target_file is given the PNG is inserted after after_block.
